description: ACTGOV Active Travel Route Public View is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). This polyline dataset shows the location of cycle routes in line with the Active Travel Plan in the Australian Capital Territory that are owned or managed by the ACT Government. This is a non-asset dataset for information only. The polylines are managed by City Services, City and Environment Directorate (CED). Coverage: ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). Its tags are access, active-travel, active-travel-plan, cbr-cycle-route, ced. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
